changes.title: Flora fits biomes
items: Trees on the far islands now suit their biome: thorn trees and the odd baobab in the bushveld, drowned mangroves in the drowned wood, snowy spruces in the frost cave and icefall, old spruces in the trollwood, cedars round the moonpool
No more date palms out on the savanna or in the jungle and mangroves, no willows in the swamps, no rainforest ironwood in the red canyon
Nearer islands blend gently into their biome: the erg's oasis has wild olives and junipers among its palms

changes.title: Biome strength
items: Biome forests deepen ring by ring: islands in the third ring are only touched by their biome, the fourth more so, the outermost in full

changes.title: Sail in bed
items: Sailing to an island always ends with her waking up in bed there: the alarm, last night's clothes in a pile, and getting dressed before the door opens, as every morning
